title: Oven-Glazed Russian Broccoli Hash
description: Sweet, crumbly, and easy to make, this Russian-inspired dish is perfect for a weeknight meal. It features Chinese broccoli, lardons, and a sweet glaze.
instructions: Toss the Chinese broccoli with a pinch of salt and a few grinds of black pepper.
Dust a baking sheet with flour and arrange the broccoli in a single layer.
Bake the broccoli in the preheated grill for 10 minutes, or until tender and slightly browned.
Meanwhile, cook the pork lardons in a skillet over medium heat until browned and crispy.
Remove the cooked lardons from the skillet and set aside.
Add the honey to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the honey has thickened into a glaze.
Add the bourbon whiskey (if using) to the skillet and stir to combine.
Toss the cooked broccoli with the lardons and glaze until well-coated.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional lardons if desired.
